info.title: Alumni Influencer Platform API
info.description: REST API for managing alumni profiles, credentials, bidding for Alumni of the Day, event participations, and API key management.

bearerAuth.description: JWT token obtained from the login endpoint

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Long-lived API key generated from the API Key Management endpoints

appearance_count.description: Number of times featured as Alumni of the Day

key_prefix.description: First 8 characters of the key for identification

key.description: The full API key — only shown once at creation time

name.description: A descriptive label for this key

expires_at.description: Expiry as a strtotime-compatible string, e.g. '+30 days', '+1 year'

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently featured Alumni of the Day. Requires an API key with the read:alumni_of_day ability.
Renders the Swagger UI for interactive API documentation.

post.description: Creates a new user account with a university email. Sends a verification email.

password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character

get.description: Verifies a user's email using a single-use token sent during registration.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token. Rate limited to 5 requests per minute.
Sends a password reset email if the account exists. Rate limited.
Resets the password using a single-use token. Revokes all active sessions.

get.description: Returns login history, endpoint breakdown, per-token usage, and recent activity.
Returns all API keys for the authenticated user, including revoked keys.

post.description: Generates a new API key. The full key value is returned only once — store it securely.

get.description: Returns usage statistics for a specific API key including total requests, endpoint breakdown, and recent activity.

delete.description: Revokes an API key, preventing further use.

400.description: Profile already exists or validation errors

get.summary: Get full profile with all credentials
get.description: Returns a profile along with degrees, certifications, licences, courses, employment history, and event participations. Requires an API key with the read:alumni ability.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional alumni user ID. Defaults to the API key owner's user ID.

get.description: Returns alumni profile summaries for directory/search use. Requires an API key with the read:alumni ability.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search first name, last name, or email.

post.description: Place a bid on the currently active slot for Alumni of the Day. Status is forced to ACTIVE server-side.

400.description: No active slot or validation errors

422.description: Amount too low or slot inactive

post.description: Cancels an active bid. Slot must still be active.
